run_dataset_info: run the utilities module info command to list books, speakers, and total hours in a Libri-Light dataset directory
get_all_metadata: get all metadata JSON files from a directory by walking the tree and filtering by suffix
load_cache: load cached data from a JSON or pickle file with an optional fallback function to regenerate
get_speaker_data: get speaker talk hours from a list of metadata files by reading audio info and speaker data JSON
get_hour_tag_repartition: get audio hours grouped by a metadata tag value across a list of metadata files
